steps.comment: Member 2 keypad feedback, BOTH outcomes — wire the spy, press E on the real keypad, deny a wrong code, then grant the real code (this also arms the silent checkpoint at the door).
steps.eval: (() => { window.__snd = []; const ap = __game.audio.play.bind(__game.audio); __game.audio.play = (n, o) => { window.__snd.push(n); return ap(n, o); }; const kp = __game.player.interactables.find((o) => Math.abs(o.position.x - 2.25) < 0.01 && Math.abs(o.position.z + 29.66) < 0.01); if (!kp) return 'keypad mesh not found'; kp.userData.onInteract(); const real = __game.ui.onKeypadSubmit; window.__wrong = __game.ui.onKeypadSubmit('9999'); __game.ui.onKeypadSubmit(__game.levels.debug.code); __game.ui.closeTopPanel(); __game.player.isLocked = true; return JSON.stringify({ found: true, wrongCodeAccepted: window.__wrong, panelStillOpen: !!__game.ui.panelOpen }); })()

steps.comment: Member 2 power-room checkpoint pad: teleport through the open door; the pad update should arm a VISIBLE checkpoint at (0,0,-31.2) and overwrite the door one. Self-heal first: headless Chrome can drop pointer lock, which pauses the loop — re-assert 'playing' via the game's own lock event contract.

steps.comment: Game-time-driven wait: the transformation takes ~4s of GAME time; headless rendering is slower than wall-clock, so poll until the emergency fade has fully settled.
steps.eval: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); let tube = 0, workOn = 0; const iv = setInterval(() => { const fog = __game.scene.fog; tube = 0; workOn = 0; __game.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && o.material && o.material.emissive && o.material.emissive.getHex && o.material.emissive.getHex() === 0xd8f2ff) tube = Math.max(tube, o.material.emissiveIntensity); if (o.isPointLight && o.userData.target !== undefined && o.visible && o.intensity > 0) workOn++; }); const done = fog.color.getHexString() === '101a2a' && Math.abs(fog.density - 0.013) < 0.0005 && Math.abs(tube - 2.4) < 0.05 && workOn === 9; if (done || Date.now() - t0 > 120000) { clearInterval(iv); resolve(done ? 'power transformation settled' : 'TIMEOUT fog=' + fog.color.getHexString() + ' d=' + fog.density.toFixed(4) + ' tube=' + tube.toFixed(2) + ' workOn=' + workOn); } }, 400); })

(() => { let work = 0, workOn = 0, redVis = 0, roomRed = -1, tube = 0, positional = 0; __game.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isLight) { if (o.isPointLight && o.userData.target !== undefined) { work++; if (o.visible && o.intensity > 0) workOn++; } if (o.isSpotLight && o.color.getHex() === 0xff1a0a && o.visible) redVis++; if (o.isPointLight && o.color.getHex() === 0xff2a14) roomRed = o.intensity; } if (o.isMesh && o.material && o.material.emissive && o.material.emissive.getHex && o.material.emissive.getHex() === 0xd8f2ff) tube = Math.max(tube, o.material.emissiveIntensity); if (o instanceof __game.THREE.PositionalAudio) positional++; }); return JSON.stringify({ fog: '#' + __game.scene.fog.color.getHexString(), density: +__game.scene.fog.density.toFixed(4), workLights: work, workLightsOn: workOn, beaconsVisible: redVis, roomRedLamp: roomRed, tubeEmissive: +tube.toFixed(2), positionalBefore: window.__posBefore, positionalAfter: positional }); })()
